topic: Students and high schoolers nationwide demand a freeze on AI development
scale: Walkouts at over 50 locations across the U.S. at universities and high schools
quote1: As part of the national demonstration, a dozen University students stood at South Lawn Tuesday afternoon in support of accountable AI regulation.
quote2: Manhattan high schoolers walked out of class this week and marched to the Lincoln Center in protest of AI in education, expressing fears that the technology is a threat to their cognitive development and job prospects.
